slides: And they ask for a number of guests. So we need both the percent and the bar. Percent times the number of guests.

slides.say: Sunday. Sixty percent plus twenty percent is eighty percent.
Eighty percent of three hundred. Ten percent of three hundred is thirty. So eighty percent is eight times thirty, two hundred forty.
Monday. Fifty plus twenty-five is seventy-five percent, of four hundred guests.
Seventy-five percent is three quarters. A quarter of four hundred is a hundred, so three quarters is three hundred.
Tuesday. Twenty-five plus twenty-five is fifty percent, of five hundred. That's half, two hundred fifty.
Thursday. Thirty plus twenty is fifty percent, of three hundred fifty. Half of three hundred fifty is a hundred seventy-five.

slides: The greatest is Monday, three hundred.

slides.say: Look at the two traps. The tallest bar is Tuesday. The biggest percent is Sunday. But neither one wins, because we need both numbers together.
